classes.about:
== Game Tips ==
Featherbow
* Featherbows are archers capable of debuffing foes and supporting allies..
Featherbow Strategy
* Can weaken enemies in a wide area with powerful debuffs, leaving those enemies susceptible to a Viking’s attacks.
Featherbow Weaknesses
* As a Flying class, they are susceptible to arrow fire.

classes.name: Feathershield
classes.about:
== Game Tips ==
Feathershield
* Feathershield are defensive-oriented warriors that are high resistant to magick attacks.
Feathershield Strategy
* PP Reflect Magick lets them turn an enemy’s magick against them. Use it well in battles against Caster classes.
Feathershield Weaknesses
* Susceptible to enemy Shieldshooters and their potent front row attacks.

classes.name: Featherstaff
classes.about:
== Game Tips ==
Featherstaff
* Featherstaves are angelic healers who are highly skilled in ensuring their allies don’t fall in battle.
Featherstaff Strategy
* PP Preemptive Heal will heal an ally just before they’re attacked, allowing them to guard the lives of severely wounded allies.
Featherstaff Weaknesses
* As a Flying class, they are susceptible to arrow fire.
